plaatsen.tekst: Who also hath made ➔ us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
